Name: Azubah, Daughter of Shilhi
Summary: Azubah, daughter of Shilhi, was the mother of Jehoshaphat, who was thirty-five when he began to reign twenty-five years in Jerusalem.
KeyStory: Azubah is named only as Jehoshaphat's mother in the record of his reign.
RelatedPeople: King Jehoshaphat; Shilhi, Father of Azubah
LifeLesson: A praying king's mother is remembered alongside his reign.
